chapter_title: Concerning the Advent of Five Fathers from the Fiv
spiritual_reading:
# Spiritual Translation

**¶2:**
The Divine Emissary of truth [GAP-1] proceeded from the Lord's inmost understanding; the Divine Love united with wisdom [GAP-2] proceeded from His interior rational faculty; the receptacle that gives birth to all spiritual life proceeded from His interior perception; [GAP-3] the Divine Love in human form proceeded from His providential deliberation; and pure innocence united with truth proceeded from His reflective contemplation.

**¶3:**
In this manner were called forth these five originating principles of Divine order. These five successive influxes of the Divine proceeded from the five essential faculties [GAP-4] of the Lord's own Being. Each proceeded from the one before it in discrete degrees, and each was made manifest according to its proper state of reception and the order of Divine providence.

---

**Translator's note on the series:** The five faculties — inmost understanding, rational thought, interior perception, deliberative wisdom, reflective contemplation — describe a descending series of discrete degrees within the Divine Mind itself. Each "emanation" is the form that Divine life assumes as it proceeds outward through these degrees. The passage teaches that every governing principle of spiritual order originates not from a separate being but from a distinct capacity within the one Divine Life, each unfolding from within the prior, as love passes through successive degrees of wisdom into manifestation. The natural language of "fathers" and "births" corresponds to the spiritual reality that each degree is an originating cause to the degree below it — fathering it, as it were — while remaining one life throughout.

reconstructions.reconstructed_text: The [Ambas]sador [came] from his mind; the Beloved of the Lights [from his thought]; the Mother of Life from his insight; [Jesus] the Beloved from his counsel; the Virgin of Lig[ht f]rom his consideration.
So in this way were summone[d these five] fathers. These five advents came from the five limbs [of the Father]. One came from another and was manifested in its season.

fills.explanation: The spiritual reading says "proceeded from," and "came" is the natural-plane Kephalaia equivalent for the act of emanation/proceeding from an interior faculty; it also establishes the verb pattern for the parallel series that follows.

The spiritual reading says "proceeded from His interior rational faculty," and "thought" is the natural-plane term in the Kephalaia's descending series of five faculties (mind, thought, insight, counsel, consideration), fitting perfectly between "mind" and "insight."

The spiritual reading identifies this figure as "the Divine Love in human form," which in the Manichaean natural-plane register is "Jesus the Beloved" — the fourth of the five evocations of the Father of Greatness, proceeding from his counsel.

The spiritual reading says "of the Lord's own Being," and "the Father" (i.e., the Father of Greatness) is the Kephalaia's standard natural-plane name for the one Divine source from whose five limbs/faculties all emanations proceed.
